answer: Require each newcomer’s first three paid tasks to be routed at random to five established reviewers outside its referral cluster. Reviewers stake a bond; a later random audit that finds copied or coordinated work slashes dishonest endorsements. To forge N identities, an attacker must fund N sets of real task work and recruit five independent reviewers per identity, each exposed to penalties. Random routing blocks a whisper campaign from choosing friendly juries, while the public thread of endorsements makes collusion auditable.
